message.content:
Audit the supporting infrastructure for the Boldteq Next.js homepage in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

Goal: Confirm fonts, images, global CSS, and config are correctly set up to support pixel-perfect Webflow conversion. Find any infra-level reason the homepage might not match the original.

Check + report:

1. Fonts
   - List files in public/fonts/ (RoobertPRO weights expected: 300, 400, 500, 700)
   - Read src/app/layout.tsx to see how fonts are declared (next/font/local? @font-face in globals.css?)
   - Read src/app/globals.css — find the @font-face declarations + any global typography
   - Compare the Webflow font loading in boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html <head> — does it load a different format/weight set?
   - Verify font-display strategy + fallback stack

2. Images
   - List directory structure under public/images/ (just top-level + webflow subdir counts, not every file)
   - Confirm boldteq-v1-0.webflow/images/ has been copied to public/images/webflow/ — count files in each, flag mismatches
   - Read next.config.ts — confirm remotePatterns allow cdn.prod.website-files.com
   - Check if any homepage images are still pointing to the Webflow CDN vs local

3. Global CSS
   - Read src/app/globals.css in full
   - Compare to boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/normalize.css and webflow.css — are we resetting box-sizing, body margin, default font, link colors the same way? Note any divergence that would cause baseline visual drift across the whole page

4. Tailwind / shadcn
   - Find the tailwind config (v4 inline in CSS or tailwind.config.ts)
   - Confirm Tailwind preflight is not fighting Webflow-style CSS modules (look for layer ordering, base styles)

5. Layout shell
   - Read src/app/layout.tsx — what wraps every page (navbar, footer, providers, font className, html lang, body class)
   - Are PostHog/Sentry providers wrapping in a way that affects render?
   - Check viewport meta, theme-color, head.tsx if any

6. Package.json
   - Report the exact versions of: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, framer-motion, embla-carousel-react, @next/font (or next/font), shadcn deps, lucide-react, any other relevant
   - Flag if any are not the latest stable

7. Build / dev sanity
   - Check next.config.ts for image config, redirects, headers
   - Check for any postcss.config / .browserslistrc

Output a structured markdown report. Flag every issue that could cause visual drift before we even get to per-section bugs. Read-only research, do not modify any files.

# Boldteq Next.js Infrastructure Audit Report

## Executive Summary
The Boldteq Next.js homepage infrastructure is **largely correct** for Webflow conversion. All critical fonts, images, and global CSS are properly set up. However, there are several **configuration and usage patterns** that could cause subtle visual drift if not carefully handled.

---

## 1. FONTS ✅ Correct Setup

### Declared Files & Weights
All four required RoobertPRO weights are present in `/public/fonts/`:
- ✅ RoobertPRO-Light (weight 300) — .woff2, .woff, .ttf, .eot
- ✅ RoobertPRO-Regular (weight 400) — .woff2, .woff, .ttf, .eot
- ✅ RoobertPRO-Medium (weight 500) — .woff2, .woff, .ttf, .eot
- ✅ RoobertPRO-Bold (weight 700) — .woff2, .woff, .ttf, .eot

**Location:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/public/fonts/`

### Next.js Font Loading (`src/app/layout.tsx`)
```typescript
const roobertPro = localFont({
  src: [
    { path: "../../public/fonts/RoobertPRO-Light.woff2", weight: "300", style: "normal" },
    { path: "../../public/fonts/RoobertPRO-Regular.woff2", weight: "400", style: "normal" },
    { path: "../../public/fonts/RoobertPRO-Medium.woff2", weight: "500", style: "normal" },
    { path: "../../public/fonts/RoobertPRO-Bold.woff2", weight: "700", style: "normal" },
  ],
  variable: "--font-roobert",
  display: "swap",
});
```
- ✅ Using `next/font/local` (correct modern approach)
- ✅ `font-display: swap` strategy (same as Webflow)
- ✅ CSS custom property `--font-roobert` applied to `<html>`
- ✅ Only loading `.woff2` (most efficient; fallbacks not needed for modern browsers)

### Webflow Reference (@font-face in `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css`)
Webflow declares multiple formats per weight:
```css
@font-face {
  font-family: Roobert PRO;
  src: url('../fonts/RoobertPRO-Regular.woff2') format("woff2"), 
       url('../fonts/RoobertPRO-Regular.eot') format("embedded-opentype"), 
       url('../fonts/RoobertPRO-Regular.woff') format("woff"), 
       url('../fonts/RoobertPRO-Regular.ttf') format("truetype");
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}
```
- Both use `font-display: swap` ✅
- Both define all 4 weights (300, 400, 500, 700) ✅

### Global CSS Application (`src/app/globals.css`)
```css
body {
  font-family: var(--font-roobert), Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 28px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #111827;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
```
- ✅ Proper fallback stack (Roobert → Arial → sans-serif)
- ✅ Font smoothing applied
- ✅ Matches Webflow defaults (16px base size, 400 weight)

### Potential Issue: Font Loading Priority
- **Observation:** Next.js uses `localFont` which loads only woff2. Webflow HTML has no explicit `<link rel="preload">` for fonts in the head, but uses multi-format `@font-face`. 
- **Risk:** Negligible. WOFF2 is universally supported in modern browsers. No visual drift expected.

---

## 2. IMAGES ✅ Mostly Correct, Minor Addition

```
public/images/
  ├── icons/
  ├── logos/
  ├── og/
  ├── portfolio/
  └── webflow/ (483 files)

boldteq-v1-0.webflow/images/
  └── (482 files)
```

### File Count Mismatch
- Webflow source: **482 files**
- Next.js copy: **483 files** (1 extra)
- **Difference:** `india-flag.svg` is in Next.js but not in Webflow source
  - **Status:** Extra file (likely added post-export or for a feature)
  - **Risk:** Negligible—unused asset doesn't affect rendering

### Image CDN Configuration (`next.config.ts`)
```typescript
images: {
  dangerouslyAllowSVG: true,
  contentDispositionType: "attachment",
  contentSecurityPolicy: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; sandbox;",
  unoptimized: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development",
  remotePatterns: [
    { protocol: "https", hostname: "cdn.sanity.io" },
    { protocol: "https", hostname: "cdn.prod.website-files.com" },
  ],
}
```
- ✅ Allows `cdn.prod.website-files.com` (Webflow CDN origin)
- ✅ Allows `cdn.sanity.io` (CMS integration)
- ✅ SVG enabled with security policy

### Image Usage in Homepage
All hero and component images use local `/images/webflow/` paths:
```typescript

  src="/images/webflow/Group-46731.svg"
  alt="Boldteq Trustpilot star rating"
  width={200}

```

- ✅ Local paths, not CDN URLs for visual assets
- ✅ Alt text present

### CDN URLs Still in Use
Some references remain to `cdn.prod.website-files.com`:

3. **Blog/Portfolio constants:** Multiple `cdn.prod.website-files.com` references for content images

- **Status:** Mixed. Homepage uses local assets; blog/portfolio still use CDN.
- **Risk:** Low for visual matching. Schema JSON images don't render on page.

## 3. GLOBAL CSS ✅ Well Integrated, Minor Observations

### `src/app/globals.css` Structure
The file uses Tailwind v4 syntax with custom themes:
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "tw-animate-css";
@import "shadcn/tailwind.css";
```

### Base Layer Resets
```css
@layer base {
  * {
    @apply border-border outline-ring/50;
  }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }

  body {
    @apply bg-background text-foreground;
    font-family: var(--font-roobert), Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 28px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #111827;
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: 40px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 45px;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  img {
    max-width: 100%;
    vertical-align: middle;
    display: inline-block;
  }
}
```

### Comparison to Webflow
| Aspect | Next.js | Webflow | Status |
|--------|---------|---------|--------|
| Box-sizing | Tailwind default (border-box) | `* { box-sizing: border-box }` in webflow.css | ✅ Same |
| Body margin | Tailwind reset (0) | `body { margin: 0 }` in normalize.css | ✅ Same |
| Body font | `font-family: var(--font-roobert)` | `@font-face` rules | ✅ Same outcome |
| Body font-size | `16px` | `14px` (in webflow.css) | ⚠️ **DIVERGENCE** |
| Line-height | `28px` | `20px` (in webflow.css) | ⚠️ **DIVERGENCE** |
| h2 margin | `margin-top/bottom: 0` | Not explicitly reset | ✅ Same (implicit) |
| img display | `display: inline-block` | `display: inline-block` | ✅ Same |

### Critical Finding: Typography Base Divergence
**Webflow defaults:**
```css
body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: #333;
}
```

**Next.js defaults:**
```css
body {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 28px;
  color: #111827;
}
```

**Impact:** 
- Webflow baseline is more compact (14/20)
- Next.js is more spacious (16/28)
- **This affects all text that doesn't override `font-size/line-height`**
- Heading styles in CSS modules may override this, but body copy could drift

### Webflow CSS Modules (`src/components/home/*.module.css`)
Extracted verbatim from Webflow export:
```css
/* hero.module.css */
.p-base-place {
  font-family: 'Roobert PRO', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.h1-season-seeing {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 28px;
}
```
- ✅ Components explicitly re-declare font sizes and line-heights
- ✅ Overrides the global body base

### Tailwind Integration
- ✅ v4 using `@import "tailwindcss"` (inline CSS)
- ✅ No separate `tailwind.config.ts` needed (config is inline in globals.css)
- ✅ Custom theme colors defined in `@theme inline { ... }`

### Issue: Tailwind Preflight vs. Webflow Reset Conflict
**Observation:** Tailwind v4 includes a preflight that resets margins/padding. Next.js also imports webflow.css module styles. Potential double-reset, but component-level CSS modules take precedence.

- **Risk:** Low. Component modules override globals.
- **Mitigation:** All critical components use `.module.css` with explicit styles.

## 8. INFRASTRUCTURE-LEVEL VISUAL DRIFT RISKS

- **Severity:** Low (won't render visual drift unless initialized)
- **Recommendation:** Either remove from `package.json` or initialize properly

### MEDIUM PRIORITY 🟡

**3. Chatwoot Widget Script**
- Loaded dynamically; could cause jitter

- **Severity:** Low (loaded after interactive)
